units.source_text: 夕雾大将常常深切关怀柏木的病，闻知他升了官，连忙来访问。

en.t: General Yugiri was always deeply concerned about Kashiwagi's illness, and when he heard that Kashiwagi had been promoted, he hurried over to visit him.

units.source_text: 前来道喜的，他是第一个呢。

en.t: Among those who came to offer congratulations, he was the very first.

units.source_text: 柏木所居的厢屋，门前停了许多车马，随从人等非常嘈杂。

en.t: In front of the wing where Kashiwagi lived, many carriages and horses were stopped, and the attendants were making a great commotion.

units.source_text: 柏木自今年以来，几乎完全不能起床了。

en.t: Since the beginning of the year, Kashiwagi had been almost completely unable to get out of bed.

units.source_text: 病中衣冠不整，未便接见高官贵客。

en.t: In his illness his dress and appearance were disordered, so it was inconvenient for him to receive such a high-ranking guest.

units.source_text: 心里很想和夕雾会面，无奈体力十分衰弱，思之不胜伤心。

en.t: He very much wanted to meet Yugiri, but his strength was terribly weakened, and thinking of it filled him with sorrow.

units.source_text: 便命人传言：“还是请阁下进里面坐吧。

en.t: So he had someone send word: "Please come inside and sit here after all.

units.source_text: 室中零乱不堪，想必能蒙恕罪。”

en.t: The room is in dreadful disorder, but I trust you will forgive me."

units.source_text: 叫祈祷僧暂时退避，在枕畔设席，请夕雾进来。

en.t: He had the prayer monks withdraw for a while, set a seat beside his pillow, and invited Yugiri in.

units.source_text: 柏木和夕雾从小亲睦，两心毫无隔阂，如今面临死别，其悲伤眷恋之情，实不亚于嫡亲兄弟。

en.t: Kashiwagi and Yugiri had been close since childhood, with no distance between their hearts, and now, facing a parting by death, their grief and attachment were no less than those of true brothers.

units.source_text: 夕雾以为今日有升官之喜，他的心情应该愉快了，如今睹此情状，心中不胜惋惜，便觉意兴索然，对他说道：“你的病怎么重到这个地步！

en.t: Yugiri had thought that today's joy of promotion would have lifted his spirits, but seeing him in this state, he was overcome with pity and lost all heart, saying to him, "How has your illness become so grave?

units.source_text: 今日大喜临门，我以为你一定好些了呢。”

en.t: With such great good fortune today, I was sure you would be somewhat better."

units.source_text: 便撩开帷屏来看他。

en.t: Then he lifted the curtain screen and looked at him.

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“真不幸啊！

en.t: Kashiwagi answered, "What misfortune this is!

units.source_text: 你看，我已经不复是从前的我了。”

en.t: Look at me; I am no longer the man I once was."

units.source_text: 他头戴一顶乌帽子，上半身略微抬起，然而样子十分痛苦。

en.t: He wore a black court cap and had raised his upper body slightly, but he looked terribly pained.

units.source_text: 他穿着好几重质料柔软可爱的白色衣服，盖着被躺在那里。

en.t: He lay there under a quilt, wearing several layers of soft, lovely white robes.

units.source_text: 室中陈设非常雅洁，熏香之气扑鼻。

en.t: The room was arranged with great elegance and purity, and the scent of incense filled the air.

units.source_text: 这住处非常舒服，虽然随便布置，却很富有趣致。

en.t: The dwelling was very comfortable, and though casually arranged, it was full of charm.

units.source_text: 大凡患重病的人，总是须发蓬松、肮脏不堪的。

en.t: Ordinarily, people suffering from serious illness have disheveled hair and beards and become quite unkempt.

units.source_text: 但柏木虽然瘦得厉害，肤色反而更白，神情反而更美了。

en.t: But although Kashiwagi had grown terribly thin, his complexion seemed even whiter, and his expression even more beautiful.

units.source_text: 他靠在枕上说话的模样，实在非常衰弱，仿佛即将断气似的。

en.t: The way he spoke while leaning against the pillow was truly feeble, as though his breath might fail at any moment.

units.source_text: 夕雾不胜惋惜，对他说道：“你生了很久的病，倒不见得那么瘦呢。

en.t: Yugiri, unable to contain his pity, said to him, "You have been ill for a long time, yet you do not seem so thin.

units.source_text: 神情反而比往常秀美了。”

en.t: Your expression is even lovelier than usual."

units.source_text: 口上如此说，手却在擦眼泪。

en.t: Though he said this aloud, his hand was wiping away tears.

units.source_text: 又对他说：“我和你不是曾有‘但愿同日死’的誓约么？

en.t: He also said, "Did we not once swear that we wished to die on the same day?

units.source_text: 这实在使我太伤心了！

en.t: This truly grieves me beyond measure!

units.source_text: 我连你何故患此重病的原因也不知道呢。

en.t: I do not even know why you have fallen into such a serious illness.

units.source_text: 像我这样亲昵的人，怎么能放心呢！”

en.t: How can someone as close to you as I am possibly be at ease?"

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“这病怎么重起来，我自己也不觉得。

en.t: Kashiwagi answered, "I myself do not know how this illness became so serious.

units.source_text: 痛苦在什么地方，也说不出来。

en.t: I cannot even say exactly where the suffering lies.

units.source_text: 我总以为不会忽然变坏，想不到日复一日，弄得如此衰弱，如今元气也丧失了。

en.t: I always thought it would not suddenly worsen, but day after day I have grown this weak, and now even my vital strength is gone.

units.source_text: 我这死不足惜之身，能够延命至今，全靠种种祈祷和誓愿的法力吧。

en.t: This life of mine, not worth regretting if it dies, has lasted until now only through the power of many prayers and vows.

units.source_text: 然而迟迟不死，反而使我痛苦，如今但愿早点死去。

en.t: Yet lingering on without dying only makes me suffer, and now I wish only to die soon.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，我在这世间难于抛舍之事，实在很多啊！

en.t: Even so, there are truly many things in this world that I find hard to abandon.

units.source_text: 事亲不能尽其天年，最可伤心；事君也是半途而废，罪愆良多。

en.t: Not being able to serve my parents until the end of their natural lives grieves me most; my service to my lord too is left unfinished, and my faults are many.

units.source_text: 而回顾自身，不能扬名立业，抱恨而死，尤觉可悲。

en.t: And when I look back on myself, dying with regrets, without having made a name or accomplished anything, seems especially sorrowful.

units.source_text: 此种世人共有的恨事，姑置不谈。

en.t: But let us set aside such regrets, which all people in the world share.

units.source_text: 但我心中另有一种痛苦，在这大限将临之时，本来不必泄露于人，然而到底难于隐忍，总想向人诉说。

en.t: There is another pain in my heart, and though at the approach of death I should not reveal it to anyone, I cannot bear to keep it hidden and long to tell someone.

units.source_text: 我有许多兄弟，但因种种关系，即使对他们隐约谈起，也不相宜，只可向你诉说：

en.t: I have many brothers, but for various reasons it would not be fitting even to hint at this to them; I can speak of it only to you:

units.source_text: 我对六条院大人，稍有得罪之处，数月以来，中心耿耿，惶恐异常。

en.t: I have in some small way offended His Lordship of Rokujo-in, and for several months my heart has been troubled and filled with extraordinary fear.

units.source_text: 但此事实在非出本意，伤心之极，自觉将成疾病。

en.t: But it truly was not my intention, and in my extreme grief I felt it would turn into illness.

units.source_text: 正在此际，忽蒙大人宣召，遂于朱雀院庆寿音乐预演之日，赴六条院叩见。

en.t: Just then, I unexpectedly received His Lordship's summons, and on the day of the music rehearsal for Suzaku-in's longevity celebration, I went to Rokujo-in to pay my respects.

units.source_text: 观其眼色，显然对我未能恕罪。

en.t: From the look in his eyes, it was clear that he had not been able to forgive me.

units.source_text: 从此愈觉人世忧患甚多，生涯全无意趣，心中骚乱之极，便弄得如此狼狈。

en.t: After that I felt all the more that human life was full of sorrow and trouble, that there was no pleasure in living, and my heart became so disturbed that I have been reduced to this wretched state.

units.source_text: 我固微不足数，我对大人自幼忠诚信赖，此次之事，恐是听信谗言之故。

en.t: I am, of course, of little account, but since childhood I have served and trusted His Lordship faithfully; I fear this matter came about because he listened to slander.

units.source_text: 我今死去，只有此恨长存于世，当然又是我后世安乐的障碍。

en.t: If I die now, only this bitterness will remain in the world, and it will surely hinder my peace in the life to come.

units.source_text: 但愿你在得便之时，禀告六条院大人，善为辩解。

en.t: I beg you, when you find a suitable chance, to report this to His Lordship of Rokujo-in and explain it well on my behalf.

units.source_text: 我死之后，若蒙大人恕罪，我就感恩不尽了。”

en.t: After I die, if I may receive His Lordship's forgiveness, I will be endlessly grateful."

units.source_text: 他越说下去，样子越是痛苦，夕雾看了非常难过。

en.t: The more he spoke, the more pained he looked, and Yugiri was deeply distressed to see it.

units.source_text: 他心中已经猜到那一件事，然而未能确实察知详情。

en.t: In his heart he had already guessed what the matter was, but he did not know the details for certain.

units.source_text: 便答道：“你何必如此多心啊！

en.t: So he answered, "Why must you torment yourself so much?

units.source_text: 家父并没有怪怨你呢。

en.t: My father does not resent you at all.

units.source_text: 他闻得你的病如此沉重，非常吃惊，悲叹不已，常在替你惋惜。

en.t: When he heard that your illness was this severe, he was greatly shocked, grieved without end, and has constantly lamented for you.

units.source_text: 你既然有了这样的心事，为什么一直闷在肚里，不告诉我呢？

en.t: Since you had such a worry, why did you keep it shut inside and not tell me?

units.source_text: 倘告诉了我，我也可奔走斡旋，使双方谅解。

en.t: If you had told me, I could have gone back and forth to mediate and help both sides understand.

units.source_text: 但时至今日，悔之晚矣！”

en.t: But now that matters have come to this, it is too late for regret!"

units.source_text: 他不胜悲戚，恨不得教时光倒流。

en.t: He was overwhelmed with grief and wished he could make time flow backward.

units.source_text: 柏木说道：“我病势略见好转之时，原想和你谈谈。

en.t: Kashiwagi said, "When my illness seemed a little better, I had meant to speak with you.

units.source_text: 但我自己万万想不到病势会如此迅速恶化，迁延至今，实在太糊涂了。

en.t: But I never imagined it would worsen so quickly, and letting it drag on until now was truly foolish of me.

units.source_text: 你切不可将此事告诉别人！

en.t: You must absolutely not tell anyone else about this.

units.source_text: 如有适当机会，务请善为说辞，向六条院大人辩解。

en.t: If a suitable opportunity arises, please choose your words carefully and explain it to His Lordship of Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 一条院那位公主，亦请随时照拂。

en.t: Please also look after the princess at Ichijo-in whenever you can.

units.source_text: 朱雀院闻我死去，必然替公主伤心，全靠你善为劝慰了。”

en.t: When Suzaku-in hears of my death, he will surely grieve for the princess, so I must rely entirely on you to comfort him well."

units.source_text: 柏木还有许多话想说，然而身心已经十分疲乏，难以支持，只得向夕雾挥一挥手，说道：“请你回去吧！”

en.t: Kashiwagi still had many things he wanted to say, but his body and mind were already so exhausted that he could not endure more, so he merely waved his hand to Yugiri and said, "Please go back now."

units.source_text: 祈祷僧等便走进来作法，母夫人和父大臣也进来了，众侍女奔走喧嚣，夕雾只得啼啼哭哭地出去了。

en.t: The prayer monks then came in to perform their rites, his mother and father the minister also entered, and amid the hurried clamor of the waiting women, Yugiri could only leave in tears.
